name: provider_outage
description: Reference, candle and intelligence providers fail in sequence, plus a stale tick, a stale candle history, a venue 5xx and a venue timeout. Expected: one reference down still trades; both down rejects with no_independent_reference_price; candle history down rejects with missing_candle_history; intelligence down only degrades the cycle; the provider circuit breaker opens and then recovers; an unanswered submission stays uncertain rather than being blindly retried.
